notes.title: Trading Cards, Badges, Emotes, Oh my!
notes.content: Orbo now has community items! Collect the forbidden cards! Embellish yourself with the peculiar badges! Use the dark emotes! Burden yourself with the accursed profile backgrounds! The power is in your hands...

notes.title: Orbo's Odyssey V1.1.2 - More Mod Fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where time trial on success events would only run once
- Fixed a bug where JComposers could not loop without causing a crash
- Fixed a bug where level binders wouldn't correctly kill players during a time trial
- New camera tracking component that behaves like Track To Player Head
- New settings for tracking scripts to align the tracking object to the head transform's rotation
- Time trials will automatically set their BGM volumes as inactive on startup, so you won't have to worry about that anymore while making mods.

notes.title: Orbo's Odyssey V1.1.1 - Modding Micropatch
notes.content:
This is a bug fix to mend an issue where using Alt+F4 to close the game while inside of a mod would erase your save data in the main campaign. 

Sorry!

notes.title: Orbo's Odyssey V1.1.0 - The Modding Update!
notes.content:
It's here! After a month of consistent work we've got modded level support for the game, and you can also get mods off the workshop!

To get the modding toolkit, visit the [url=https://github.com/FeverDevJohnny/orbomodkit]github repo[/url] to learn how to start making mods.

You can visit the workshop and grab the Orbo's Modyssey mod to run around a test level.

Anyhow, here's a list of changes that were made to the game:

[list]
[*] Workshop support!
[*] Modding Toolkit!
[*] Changed game's rendering path to Forward to be mod-compliant.
[*] Shadows on the highest quality setting are significantly more pretty now.
[*] Fixed some bugs with the camera that were causing weird snapping issues in cutscenes.
[*] Attempted to resolve an issue with loading the game that caused the splash screen video to not play.
[*] Attempted to resolve a bug with the options menu that caused nothing to load.
[/list]

notes.title: Game devs announce plans to drop Unity, urge players to protest new per-install fees
notes.content:
Several game developers have called on their players to protest Unity's recently announced new pricing structure, under which developers who reach a certain threshold of revenue or game installations will be charged every time somebody installs their game. A few teams have also announced plans to dump Unity and move their projects to other game engines, such as Godot or Unreal.

notes.title: Orbo's Odyssey - V1.0.1
notes.content:
[list]

[*] The text in the tutorial world now changes if you unplug/plug in a controller.
[*] Resolved some typos here and there.
[/list]
